name: abap2ui5-agent
description: Every abap2UI5 app is agent-operable - an ABAP-native MCP endpoint that lets AI agents read and operate abap2UI5 apps as the real SAP user.

scripts.syfixes: find src -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:cloud && npm run check:abap2ui5
